strapiBlog.title: A Vision of Luxury: Top Off-Plan Projects by Binghatti Dubai
strapiBlog.short_description: Binghatti Properties has earned a distinguished reputation in Dubai’s real estate market. Known for its super luxury projects.

data.text:
Binghatti Properties has earned a distinguished reputation in Dubai’s real estate market. Known for its super luxury projects, Binghatti has established itself as one of the leading developers in the UAE. The brand has introduced an array of extraordinary developments in the city’s prime locations. Let us tell you about some of the best Binghatti off-plan projects in Dubai that everyone is talking about.

About the Developer

Dr. Hussain Binghatti founded Binghatti in 2008 with the vision of establishing a real estate brand defined by its distinctive and consistent visual identity. Drawing inspiration from the automotive and horological industries, Binghatti has collaborated with prestigious global brands such as Bugatti, Mercedes-Benz, and Jacob & Co. over the years. This partnership has resulted in unique, innovation-driven projects that epitomize modern living in the heart of Dubai.

New Binghatti Launches in Dubai: Branded Residences

Burj Binghatti at Business Bay

Set to exceed 100 levels, the Burj Binghatti will be the world’s tallest residential hypertower, redefining the Dubai skyline. Located in the prime district of Business Bay, this iconic skyscraper will offer breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa and the surrounding cityscape. The project is a result of a prestigious partnership between Binghatti Developers and renowned American luxury watchmakers, Jacob & Co., blending architectural brilliance with luxury craftsmanship.

A standout feature of the branded residences in Dubai is its diamond-shaped crystal crown, symbolizing its elegance and stature. Among its exclusive residences, the most expensive unit is a 7-bedroom Billionaire Sky Penthouse, spanning two floors, designed for those seeking the pinnacle of luxury living.

  • Number of bedrooms: 2 and 3 bedroom suites and penthouses
  • Community: Business Bay

Bugatti Residences

In a groundbreaking collaboration, two prestigious brands—Bugatti and Binghatti—have come together to create a masterpiece, Bugatti Residences at Business Bay. The opulent property comprises 171 Riviera Mansions and 11 Sky Mansion Penthouses. The design showcases what Bugatti is renowned for—elegance, precision, and luxury. Residents enjoy exclusive amenities including a private garage, personal pool, valet service, housekeeping, and even a private chef, ensuring a lifestyle of ultimate luxury and convenience.

Located just minutes from Burj Khalifa, Dubai Marina, and other key destinations, the development offers unmatched convenience. Offering breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa and other iconic skyscrapers, Bugatti Residences at Business Bay also integrates cutting-edge smart home technologies for a truly modern living experience.

  • Number of bedrooms: 2 to 4-bedroom mansions and penthouses
  • Community: Business Bay

Mercedes-Benz Places

A collaborative venture between automotive giant Mercedes Benz and the renowned developer, Mercedes Benz Places, is one of Dubai's most highly anticipated off-plan projects. Rising majestically to a height of 341 meters over 65 stories, this iconic residence is all set to redefine luxury on Downtown Dubai's skyline.

The ultra-luxury apartments and penthouses with private pools set a new benchmark for luxurious and intelligent living. Smart home technologies with intelligent mobility solutions are meticulously integrated at the core of the residences. The list of Mercedes-Benz Places includes a spa, infinity pool, gym, and food and beverage outlets.

  • Number of bedrooms: 2 to 4-bedroom apartments and penthouses
  • Community: Downtown Dubai

data.text:
Other Binghatti Off-Plan Projects 

Binghatti Ghost

Binghatti Ghost is one of the latest projects by the master developer that provides residents with both luxury and convenience. The high-rise towers feature 770 residential units with six retail outlets. Residents have access to an array of facilities, including an expansive swimming pool, a luxurious lobby, a state-of-the-art gym, and more. Located at Al Jaddaf, the Binghatti Ghost development enjoys proximity to all key areas from Downtown Dubai to Festival City.

  • Number of bedrooms: Studio to 3-bedroom apartments
  • Community: Al Jaddaf

One by Binghatti

Discover an exclusive waterfront lifestyle amidst high-rise apartments, commercial towers, and dazzling hotels at Marasi Drive, the heart of Business Bay. One by Binghatti is indeed a one-of-a-kind project complemented by a curated selection of amenities, ranging from enjoying a relaxing spa to meditating at the yoga zone. Other facilities like an outdoor pool, fitness centers, and access to parks and recreational areas further enhance the living experience at One by Binghatti.

There are various accommodation options to choose from, including studios, royal suites, and townhouses. The residences offer breathtaking views of Dubai Water Canal, Burj Khalifa, and other attractions. The development is a unique investment opportunity built on one of the area's last off-plan plots.

  • Number of bedrooms: Studio to 4-bedroom units
  • Community: Business Bay

Binghatti Royale

Another upcoming off plan project by Binghatti Developers, Binghatti Royale, is a luxury residential property nestled with Jumeirah Village Circle. The aesthetically pleasing skyscraper consists of spacious and stylish apartments boasting panoramic views of the serene community.

The amenities for the residents include a meticulously landscaped garden and outdoor dining areas, a lounge pool, and an outdoor gym. There are high-end retail stores on the ground floor and ample parking space for added convenience. Being part of the JVC district, the development is close to everything from tourist attractions to business hubs.

  • Number of bedrooms: 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments
  • Community: Jumeirah Village Circle

Binghatti Phoenix

Binghatti Phoenix is a modern tower located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle. One of the best Binghatti off-plan projects will include studio, 1, and 2-bedroom units offering views of the tranquil surroundings and beyond. The accessibility to schools, hospitals, and supermarkets makes Binghatti Phoenix an ideal option for families. Home buyers and investors can choose from about 434 home units offering views of the open landscape.

  • Number of bedrooms:  Studio, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments
  • Community: Jumeirah Village Circle

Binghatti Hills

Binghatti Hills at Dubai Science Park is a luxurious residential development by Binghatti Developers. The project's highlights include smart home features and state-of-the-art interiors. The towers, rising to 41 floors, provide residents unparalleled views of the Dubai skyline. 

Binghatti Hills is strategically located in Al Barsha South within Dubai Science Park. The development offers easy access to major roads such as Al Khail Road and Um Suqeim Road, ensuring an easy commute across Dubai.

  • Number of bedrooms: Studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments
  • Community: Dubai Science Park

Binghatti Phantom

Binghatti Phantom is another off-plan project by the luxury real estate developer. Binghatti Phantom at JVC features high-quality materials like marble, wood, and glass, thoughtfully integrated into every space to create an atmosphere of refined luxury. These tranquil residences offer expansive floor plans, with stylish balcony areas that invite residents to enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding neighborhood. Deluxe amenities, including swimming pools, landscaped gardens, and retail shops, cater to every lifestyle need, ensuring a perfect balance of comfort and convenience.

  • Number of bedrooms: 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments
  • Community: JVC

modules.title: FAQs About Best Binghatti Off Plan Projects

faqs.question: How many projects does Binghatti have?

data.answer: Binghatti, as of 2024, has developed over 100 projects across the UAE. Their portfolio includes a wide range of residential, commercial, and mixed-use developments, with a strong presence in Dubai. Binghatti is known for its innovative architecture and collaborations with global luxury brands such as Bugatti and Jacob & Co.

faqs.question: What is the status of Burj Binghatti?

data.answer: The Burj Binghatti Jacob & Co Residences is one of the best Binghatti properties to invest in. The expected completion date of the underdevelopment project at Business Bay is Q4-2026.

faqs.question: What are the key design elements of Mercedes-Benz Places?

data.answer: The high-rise tower has a curved top and Mercedes-Benz logo on the exterior, providing clear views of the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai skyline. Its design has three main features: balconies arranged in a unique horizontal pattern, a striking outer frame, and a southern wall with special cladding that protects from the heat and captures solar energy for better efficiency.
